categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou QingYue Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: PMOLED (Passive Matrix Organic Light-Emitting Diode) displays, electronic paper modules, and silicon-based OLED microdisplays. These products serve various applications including smart home appliances, medical health, automotive industrial control, consumer electronics, wearable displays, retail, and near-eye XR (extended reality) displays.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced OLED technologies including PMOLED, electronic paper with triple and quadruple gate display driving schemes, and silicon-based OLED microdisplays. It employs integrated manufacturing processes covering device design, material selection, thin-film encapsulation, laser cutting, and intelligent manufacturing. The company also emphasizes R&D in transparent displays, display-touch integration, high brightness and narrow bezel designs, and advanced micro-lens structures to enhance brightness and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading brands in consumer electronics, smart home appliances, medical devices, automotive displays, and XR devices. Notable clients are Huawei, Xiaomi, Samsung, LG, and Han’s Laser Technology. The company serves global markets with a strong presence in China, supplying display modules for smart home appliances, medical instruments, automotive control panels, wearable devices, and emerging XR applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Kunshan, Suzhou, and subsidiaries in Yiwu and Jiujiang. It serves both domestic and international markets, with export sales accounting for a portion of revenue. The company’s supply chain and customer base are global, but its main operational footprint is in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: QingYue operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of OLED display modules and electronic paper modules. It sources raw materials such as OLED films and electronic paper membranes from upstream suppliers and sells finished display modules to downstream device manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in PMOLED, electronic paper, and silicon-based OLED technologies, with significant R&D investment focused on high resolution, low power consumption, high contrast, and reliability improvements. It pursues industry-academia collaborations for breakthrough technologies, including microdisplays for XR, transparent displays, and intelligent manufacturing. Future R&D aims include integrated display and functional chips, screen sound, touch, encryption, and olfactory technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of OLED display modules and electronic paper modules. The company employs a combination of direct sales and distribution channels, selling customized display solutions to device manufacturers and system integrators. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns on financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: QingYue is a leading player in the global PMOLED market, ranking among the top two worldwide. It holds a strong position in electronic paper modules, ranking fourth globally by shipment volume. In silicon-based OLED microdisplays, the company is in a growth phase competing with international firms like Sony and domestic players. It is recognized as a technology leader with multiple national awards and patents, competing against companies such as BOE, Han’s Laser, and other OLED and electronic paper manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, QingYue reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 753 million, a 13.96% increase year-over-year. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 69.5 million, the loss narrowed compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets were around RMB 1.82 billion, with a net asset value of approximately RMB 1.03 billion. R&D expenses accounted for 9.24% of revenue, reflecting a strategic focus on innovation. Cash flow from operations turned positive in 2024, indicating improving operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: QingYue emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities and proprietary technologies in OLED and electronic paper displays, offering highly customized, high-performance display solutions with advantages in brightness, power efficiency, resolution, and reliability. Its products support diverse applications from smart home to XR devices, backed by a robust intellectual property portfolio and quality management systems. The company’s integration of advanced manufacturing and intelligent production lines enhances product quality and cost competitiveness, positioning it as a trusted partner for global brands.
